card.summary: 5 GB Git + 20 GB packages + 10 GB Git LFS + 10 GB attachments per account/organization; unlimited public and private repositories

free_tier.stated: 5 GB Git + 20 GB packages + 10 GB Git LFS + 10 GB attachments per account/organization; unlimited public and private repositories

retention.stated: Single small operator on one Hetzner box; nightly off-site backups with 90-day retention described as disaster recovery, not per-account restore

egress.terms: Download traffic for packages, container images and LFS is counted per account per month but 'There is no limit today'. Unlimited, and the endpoint is Cloudflare-fronted. Git clones, release assets and attachments are explicitly not counted.

record.tooling: Full Forgejo API v1 (packages, generic, OCI registry, releases, LFS) + rclone's Gitea/Forgejo-compatible WebDAV-free REST via any HTTP client; OCI via ORAS/skopeo; package registry speaks Generic/Docker/npm/PyPI etc.
record.chaining: Unlimited free accounts -> 5+20+10+10 = 45 GB of separately-metered pools per identity. Because packages (20 GB) and LFS (10 GB) are separate pools from Git (5 GB), one account yields ~45 GB across four subjects, and each further account carries the same 45 GB. Registry blobs are anonymous-pullable, so shard across repos like any OCI store.
record.limits_note: Per-account quotas only (5 GB git / 20 GB packages / 10 GB LFS / 10 GB attachments). Download counter booked hourly at the edge proxy; a limit will be set later (currently 429 only after an as-yet-unset threshold). Uploads and Git ops never blocked by traffic limits. 2500 CI minutes/month.
record.reliability_note: Single small operator on one Hetzner box; nightly off-site backups with 90-day retention described as disaster recovery, not per-account restore. Explicit published policy of monitoring several accounts used to exceed its quota and deleting/suspending. The chaining path is actively watched, unlike GitLab's.
